ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: Culture Notes - Protecting Elves, Protecting Nature

fullPassage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being protected!

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's (A)[folk / fork] culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to (B)[imagine / image] that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these (C)[imaginary / imaginative] beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 아이슬란드의 민속 문화와 신화의 중요한 부분이었으며, 대부분의 아이슬란드인들은 엘프가 존재한다고 상상하기를 좋아한다. 이 상상의 존재들.
det.analysis: ✅ (A) folk: '민속'을 뜻하는 형용사. fork(포크)는 문맥 부적합. ✅ (B) imagine: '상상하다'라는 동사. image(이미지)는 명사로 that절 앞에 올 수 없음. ✅ (C) imaginary: '상상의, 가공의' — 실재하지 않는 존재. imaginative(상상력이 풍부한)는 사람의 능력을 수식.
det.tip: folk culture: 민속 문화. imaginary(상상의) vs imaginative(상상력이 풍부한): 대상 vs 능력 차이.

questions.passage: Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to (A)[respect / suspect] and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about (B)[digging / dragging] up the country's beautiful natural (C)[landscapes / landmarks]. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being protected!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 바위와 언덕을 존중하고 보호하는 것이 중요하다. 아름다운 자연 지형을 파헤치는 것에 관해 재차 생각한다.
det.analysis: ✅ (A) respect: '존중하다'. suspect(의심하다)는 보호와 병렬되기에 부적합. ✅ (B) digging: 'dig up(파헤치다)'. dragging(끌다)은 자연경관과 어울리지 않음. ✅ (C) landscapes: '자연 지형/풍경'. landmarks(랜드마크)는 인공 구조물 의미가 강함.
det.tip: dig up: 파헤치다. landscape(경관, 지형) vs landmark(랜드마크, 기념물).

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an (A)[emotional / emotionless] connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Also, plans for the (B)[construction / destruction] of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes (C)[changed / charged]. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being protected!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 정서적인 연결성을 준다. 도로, 공장, 다리 건설을 위한 계획들은 때때로 변경된다.
det.analysis: ✅ (A) emotional: '정서적인' 연결. emotionless(무감정한)는 정반대. ✅ (B) construction: '건설'. destruction(파괴)은 계획의 대상으로 부적합. ✅ (C) changed: 계획이 '변경된다'. charged(청구/충전되다)는 문맥 불일치.
det.tip: emotional connection: 정서적 유대. construction(건설) vs destruction(파괴): 접두사 con-(함께) vs de-(분리).

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for ①<u>centuries</u>, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional ②<u>disconnection</u> to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to ③<u>respect</u> and protect rocks and hills because they are ④<u>homes</u> for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ ①centuries(수 세기): 오랜 기간을 의미. 원문 그대로. ❌ ②disconnection(단절): 원문은 connection(연결). 엘프에 대한 관심이 자연에 대한 '연결성'을 주므로 disconnection은 정반대. ✅ ③respect(존중하다): 바위와 언덕을 '존중하다'. 원문 그대로. ✅ ④homes(집): 엘프의 '집'. 원문 그대로.
det.tip: connection(연결) ↔ disconnection(단절). 접두사 dis-는 반대 의미를 만듦.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings ①<u>deprives</u> them of an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to ②<u>respect</u> and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural ③<u>landscapes</u>. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes ④<u>altered</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 상상의 존재들에 대한 관심은 그들에게 자연에 대한 연결성을 준다.
det.analysis: ❌ ①deprives(빼앗다): 원문은 gives(준다). 관심이 연결성을 '주는' 것이지 '빼앗는' 것이 아님. ✅ ②respect(존중하다): 바위와 언덕을 '존중하다'. 원문 그대로. ✅ ③landscapes(경관): 원문 그대로. ✅ ④altered(변경된): 원문 changed와 같은 뜻. 적절.
det.tip: give(주다) ↔ deprive(빼앗다). deprive A of B: A에게서 B를 빼앗다.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are ①<u>habitats</u> for elves. Therefore, people think twice about ②<u>preserving</u> the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads are sometimes ③<u>modified</u>. Thanks to the elves, nature is being ④<u>protected</u>!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 따라서, 사람들은 그 나라의 아름다운 자연 지형을 파헤치는 것에 관해 재차 생각한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①habitats(서식지): homes(집)과 유사 의미. 적절. ❌ ②preserving(보존하는): 원문은 digging up(파헤치는). '자연경관을 파헤치는 것에 대해 다시 생각한다'이므로 preserving(보존)은 문맥 반대. think twice about preserving이면 보존을 망설인다는 뜻이 되어 글의 자연보호 주제에 모순. ✅ ③modified(수정된): changed와 같은 뜻. 적절. ✅ ④protected(보호받는): 원문 그대로.
det.tip: dig up(파헤치다) ↔ preserve(보존하다). think twice about ~ing: ~하는 것에 대해 재차 생각하다(주저하다).

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these __________ beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis: ❌ imagined(상상된): 과거분사로 가능하나 원문은 imaginary. ❌ imaginable(상상할 수 있는): 가능성을 의미. ❌ imaginative(상상력이 풍부한): 사람의 능력. ✅ imaginary(상상의, 가공의): 실재하지 않는 존재를 수식. 원문 그대로.
det.tip: imaginary: 상상의, 실재하지 않는. imagine(동사) → imaginary(형용사) → imagination(명사).

questions.passage: Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural __________. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being protected!
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ landscapes(지형, 풍경): 원문 그대로. 자연의 아름다운 '경관'. ❌ landmarks(랜드마크): 유명한 건축물이나 기념물. ❌ landslides(산사태): 자연재해. ❌ landlords(집주인): 사람을 지칭.
det.tip: landscape: 경관, 풍경. land(땅) + scape(모양) = 땅의 모양/경관.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the __________ of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being protected!
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis: ❌ destruction(파괴): 계획이 '변경'되는 맥락에 부적합. ✅ construction(건설): 원문 그대로. 도로, 공장, 다리를 '건설'하는 계획. ❌ instruction(교육, 지시): 도로 건설과 무관. ❌ obstruction(방해): 계획의 대상으로 부자연스러움.
det.tip: construction: 건설. con-(함께) + struct(쌓다) + -tion(명사). 관련어: construct(건설하다), constructive(건설적인).

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and <u>myths</u> for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves.
questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 'myths'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis: ❌ facts(사실): 신화는 사실과 다름. ❌ histories(역사): 실제 기록과는 다른 개념. ✅ legends(전설): myths(신화)와 가장 유사한 의미. 둘 다 전해 내려오는 이야기. ❌ customs(관습): 문화적 관행으로 이야기와는 다름.
det.tip: myth(신화) ≒ legend(전설): 둘 다 전해 내려오는 이야기이나, myth는 초자연적 요소가 강함.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to <u>respect</u> and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes.
questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 'respect'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis: ❌ ignore(무시하다): 정반대 의미. ❌ suspect(의심하다): 존중과 무관. ❌ inspect(검사하다): 살펴보는 행위. ✅ honor(존경하다): respect와 가장 유사. 둘 다 '존중하다/경의를 표하다'의 의미.
det.tip: respect ≒ honor: 존중하다, 경의를 표하다. respect은 -spect(보다) 어근 포함.

questions.passage: Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people <u>think twice</u> about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed.
questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 'think twice'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 자연 지형을 파헤치는 것에 관해 재차 생각한다.
det.analysis: ❌ decide quickly(빨리 결정하다): 재차 생각하는 것과 반대. ✅ hesitate(주저하다): think twice(재차 생각하다)와 가장 가까운 의미. 행동 전에 신중하게 고려한다는 뜻. ❌ refuse completely(완전히 거부하다): 재고와 거부는 다름. ❌ agree readily(쉽게 동의하다): 반대 의미.
det.tip: think twice: 재차 생각하다, 신중히 고려하다 ≒ hesitate(주저하다). 행동하기 전에 한 번 더 생각한다는 의미.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and <u>protect</u> rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes.
questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 'protect'와 의미가 반대인 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ endanger(위험에 빠뜨리다): protect(보호하다)의 반의어. ❌ defend(방어하다): protect와 유사. ❌ shelter(보호하다): protect와 유사. ❌ guard(지키다): protect와 유사.
det.tip: protect(보호하다) ↔ endanger(위험에 빠뜨리다). en-(만들다) + danger(위험) = 위험하게 만들다.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to <u>imagine</u> that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves.
questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 'imagine'과 의미가 반대인 것은?

det.analysis: ❌ fantasize(공상하다): imagine과 유사. ❌ suppose(추측하다): imagine과 유사. ✅ verify(확인하다, 검증하다): 상상이 아닌 사실을 '확인'하는 것. imagine(상상)의 반대. ❌ envision(상상하다): imagine과 유사.
det.tip: imagine(상상하다) ↔ verify(확인하다, 검증하다). 상상 vs 사실 확인.

questions.passage: Elves have been an important <u>part</u> of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves.
questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 'part'가 본문에서 사용된 의미와 같은 것은?
ch: She played the part of a queen in the movie.
He took part in the competition.
Please part your hair in the middle.
Music is an essential part of our daily lives.

det.analysis: ❌ ① part = 역할 (배우의 역할). ❌ ② take part in = 참가하다 (관용구). ❌ ③ part = 가르다 (동사). ✅ ④ part = 부분 — 본문과 동일. 'an important part of ~'와 'an essential part of ~' 모두 '~의 중요한 부분'.
det.tip: part: 다의어. (1) 부분 (2) 역할 (3) 참여(take part in) (4) 가르다(동사). 본문에서는 '부분'.

questions.passage: Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed.
questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어를 본문에서 찾을 때, 가장 적절한 것은?
"the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal"

det.analysis: ❌ culture(문화): 땅의 시각적 특징이 아님. ❌ nature(자연): 넓은 개념이지 구체적 시각적 특징 아님. ❌ hills(언덕): 지형의 일부일 뿐 전체 개념 아님. ✅ landscapes(지형, 풍경): 'the visible features of an area of land(땅의 눈에 보이는 특징)'과 정확히 일치.
det.tip: landscape: 경관, 풍경. 어원: land(땅) + scape(모양/형태).

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an __________ connection to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 주어진 단어의 올바른 형태를 고르시오. [emotion]

det.korean: 이 상상의 존재들에 대한 관심은 그들에게 정서적인 연결성을 준다.
det.analysis: ❌ emotionless(무감정한): 연결과 어울리지 않음. ✅ emotional(정서적인): 명사 connection을 수식하는 형용사. 원문 그대로. ❌ emotionally(감정적으로): 부사로 명사 수식 불가. ❌ emotioned: 존재하지 않는 형태.
det.tip: emotion(명사: 감정) → emotional(형용사: 감정적인) → emotionally(부사: 감정적으로).

questions.passage: In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. Thanks to the elves of Iceland, nature is being __________!
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 주어진 단어의 올바른 형태를 고르시오. [protection]

det.analysis: ❌ protective(보호하는): 형용사이나 'is being protective'는 '보호적인 태도를 취하고 있다'라는 뜻으로 수동태가 아님. ❌ protectively(보호적으로): 부사. ✅ protected(보호받는): 'is being protected'는 현재진행 수동태. 원문 그대로. ❌ protector(보호자): 명사로 be동사 뒤에 부적합.
det.tip: is being + p.p.: 현재진행 수동태 (~되고 있다). protection(명사) → protect(동사) → protected(과거분사).

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. Icelanders' interest in these imaginary beings gives them an emotional __________ to nature. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis: ✅ connection(연결): 관심이 자연과의 정서적 '연결성'을 준다. 원문 그대로. ❌ objection(반대): 자연에 대한 감정과 무관. ❌ rejection(거부): 자연에 대한 관심과 반대. ❌ restriction(제한): 정서적 유대와 무관.
det.tip: emotional connection: 정서적 유대/연결. connect(연결하다) → connection(연결).

questions.passage: Elves have been an important part of Iceland's folk culture and myths for centuries, and most Icelanders like to imagine that elves exist among them. In Icelandic culture, it is important for people to respect and protect rocks and hills because they are homes for elves. Therefore, people think twice about digging up the country's beautiful natural landscapes. Also, plans for the construction of roads, factories, and bridges are sometimes changed. __________ the elves of Iceland, nature is being protected!
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis: ❌ In spite of(~에도 불구하고): 역접 관계로 보호와 모순. ❌ Regardless of(~에 관계없이): 양보 관계로 부적합. ❌ Instead of(~ 대신에): 대체 관계로 부적합. ✅ Thanks to(~ 덕분에): 원인-결과 관계. 엘프에 대한 믿음 '덕분에' 자연이 보호된다.
det.tip: Thanks to: ~ 덕분에 (긍정적 원인). ↔ Because of: ~ 때문에 (중립적 원인).
